verdict.rationale: Kong is not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair applicable axis, and evidence shows Kong ships MCP server capability via AI Gateway (MCP autogeneration, governance, security) plus a dedicated Konnect MCP server documented at konnect-mcp/, allowing agents to connect via a first-party MCP endpoint. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of an agent successfully connecting to Kong's MCP server beyond first-party docs.
